sn15.10:1.1: Bhagavā Rājagahe Gijjhakūṭe pabbate || || Tatra || || voca || ||
sn15.10:2.1: Anamataggāyam bhikkhave saṃsāro || pe|| || Ekapuggalassa bhikkhave kappaṃ sandhāvato saṃsarato siyā evam mahā aṭṭhikaṅkalo aṭṭhipuñjo aṭṭhirāsi || yathāyam Vepullo pabbato sace saṃhārako assa sambhatañca na vinasseyya || || Taṃ kissa hetu || || Anamataggāyam bhikkhave saṃsāro || pe|| || alaṃ vimuccitunti || ||
sn15.10:3.1: Idam avoca Bhagavā || idaṃ vatvāna Sugato athāparam etad avoca satthā || ||
sn15.10:4.1: Ekassekena kappena || puggalassaṭṭhisañcayo || siyā pabbatasamo rāsi || iti vuttam mahesinā ||1||
sn15.10:5.1: So kho panāyam akkhāto || Vepullo pabbato mahā || uttaro Gijjhakūṭassa || Magadhānam giribbajo ||2||
sn15.10:6.1: Yato ariyasaccāni || sammappaññāya passati || dukkhaṃ dukkhasamuppādaṃ || dukkhassaca atikkamaṃ ||3|| Ariyaṭṭhaṅgikam maggaṃ || dukkhūpasamagāminaṃ ||
sn15.10:7.1: sasattakkhattuṃ paramaṃ || sandhāvitvāna puggalo || dukkhassantakaro hoti || sabbasaṃyojanakkhayā ti ||4|| Dasamaṃ || || Pathamo vaggo || ||
sn15.10:8.0: Tassa uddānaṃ || || Tiṇakaṭṭhaṃ ca Pathavī || Assa Khīraṃ ca Pabbataṃ || Sāsapā Sāvakā Gaṅgā || Daṇḍo ca Puggalenā ti || ||
